description: Put topics from the menu into the NEXT Deep AI Dive run: drafts questions for ONLY the given topics and appends them to the saved config. Existing topics, their questions (including edits) and the markets are left untouched. Does NOT start a run. COSTS PLATFORM LLM SPEND (a few Claude calls per topic) and takes a minute or more, so it returns immediately with questionsPending:true and drafts in the background. While it works, a probe run is refused as 'running'. Poll ai_visibility_topics_list until the ids show selected=true (or ai_visibility_run_status shows an error if drafting failed), then call ai_visibility_run. Typical flow for 'add 2 topics and rerun': ai_visibility_topic_add x2, then ONE ai_visibility_topic_include with both ids (they are drafted together; a second call while the first is drafting is refused), wait, then ai_visibility_run. Requires PRO+ and an existing saved config. Refusals return { included: false, refusal } with refusal one of tier_upgrade_required, running, no_config (set up the Deep AI Dive once in the dashboard first) or unknown_topic.

topicIds.description: Topic ids from ai_visibility_topics_list or ai_visibility_topic_add's addedTopicId. Max 10 per call.

name: ai_visibility_topic_include
